steps: 1. STRATEGIES=decent SEEDS="2" TAG=repro EXTRA="--skip-tutorial" qa/bots/run_batch.sh <scratch dir> (current build, skills.json unchanged).
2. Read the RESULT line: outcome loss, ending END_BANKRUPT at cycle 24, final cash -1659, ships 0, repossessions 6.
expected: Decent player wins between cycles 22 and 30 (seeds 1, 3 and 4 of the same strategy do, at cycles 27, 27 and 28).
actual: Cash falls from 1028 at cycle 11 to -1419 at cycle 24; the run is repossessed to zero ships. Removing BIO_3 or MIN_3 gives the same loss; removing MIL_5 or LUX_5 changes the end to a non-win at cycle 40. The outcome is knife-edge on this seed.

steps: 1. STRATEGIES=never_expand SEEDS="1 2 3 4" TAG=repro EXTRA="--skip-tutorial" qa/bots/run_batch.sh <scratch dir>.
2. In the RESULT, permits_bought is 0 and workshops_built contains [11, "munitions"]; workshop_state munitions is "stalled", workshop_reason "needs energy,chips" for the rest of the run.
expected: Munitions cannot be built while system 2 is closed (data/availability.json workshop munitions: visible_when MIL_1 AND system_open:2).
actual: game/main.gd can_build_workshop (line 1840) checks only the skill unlock, the station and cash, not system_open:2. The bot built a 900-credit workshop at cycle 11 that can never run. Seen in 4 of 4 never_expand runs. Whether the player UI can reach this build path is UNKNOWN; the bot calls build_workshop directly.

steps: 1. Read data/story_text.json entry EV19_EVICT_EFF: "The asteroids open for mining. Some nomads turn to piracy, and pirates rise."
2. grep -rn pirates_active game/: the variable is declared in game/route_engine.gd:36 and read at line 641, but no line sets it true.
3. grep -rn pirate_nomads_per_eviction game/: no reader. data/balance.json pirate_volume_penalty 0.3 is read only through the unset flag.
expected: A notice names only effects the build makes. Either pirates rise and cut volume, or the line does not say so.
actual: No pirate system runs. The line promises pirates that never appear. Not reproduced in a live run; static finding from the code paths above.

steps: 1. Read data/story_text.json entries SK_MIL_1_PLAIN, SK_MIN_1_PLAIN, SK_MIN_4_PLAIN, SK_BIO_1_PLAIN, SK_LUX_4_NAME and SK_LUX_4_PLAIN.
2. Compare each named good with its rule in data/availability.json at the time the node is shown (start of run).
expected: CLAUDE.md availability rule: texts (tooltips included) must not name a good that is hidden at that moment.
actual: SK_MIL_1_PLAIN names pulse cells (hidden until MIL_1, munitions and system 2). SK_MIN_1_PLAIN names ingot (hidden until smelter and ore visible) and the Fabric (hidden until nullglass is visible). SK_MIN_4_PLAIN names seam alloy (hidden until plate and ingot are visible). SK_BIO_1_PLAIN names bio-gel (hidden until culture lab and system 2). The draft texts for LUX_1 (cask), LUX_4 (gems) and MIN_6 (alloy) would repeat the problem. UNKNOWN whether the _test_availability text scan covers SK_* ids.

steps: 1. First batch of this review: STRATEGIES=<each> SEEDS="1 2 3 4" qa/bots/run_batch.sh <dir> with no EXTRA flags.
2. Read decisions_total and cash_by_cycle in the RESULT lines.
expected: The bot takes turns and trades (decisions above 0 per run).
actual: All 20 runs made 0 decisions; cash stayed at 2100 for 27 cycles and the run ended as a loss. The tutorial gate blocks ship buys and orders for a bot that never passes it. Rerun with --skip-tutorial works. The batch default should carry the flag.

strategy: decent, sloppy, always_expand, never_expand, plus focused variants
steps: 1. Count skill_log and tech_done over the 40 runs in qa/reports/2026-11-05-skill-review-runs.jsonl.
expected: Each node the skill review judges can be reached and felt by at least one bot run.
actual: Bots build one workshop only (qa/bots/bot_run.gd _workshop_turn, IDS order, smelter first). Atelier and culture lab were never built in 40 runs; munitions only in never_expand, where it stalled. Never learned in any run: MIL_2, MIL_4, MIL_6, MIL_7, LUX_2, LUX_4, LUX_6, LUX_7, BIO_2, BIO_4, BIO_5, BIO_6, BIO_7, MIN_7. Rare: MIN_5 and MIN_6 (2 of 40 each). The lux-focus run cannot feed cask, because food is bio-market and the focus carries no bio lanes.

steps: 1. Read the draft MIL_3 row: event_immune targets pirate and debris route events.

2. grep -rn pirates_active game/ (no setter, see static_story_EV19) and check events.gd: the only live route event is EV17, route efficiency down, applied through debris_planets in route_engine.gd:639-640.
expected: Every immunity target exists in the build, or the node says it is for a later system.
actual: The pirate half of MIL_3 has no source and does nothing. Only the debris half is live. The event_immune effect type has no code yet, so the node is untestable now.

strategy: none (static check of the draft availability note)
steps: 1. Read data/availability.json good gems visible_when (current): LUX_1, atelier, good_visible ore, good_visible silk.
2. Read its note: 'all must be visible (ore, silk, musk)'.
expected: The rule lists every recipe input named in the note, including musk (goods.json gems recipe: ore 2, silk 1, musk 1).
actual: musk is not in visible_when. It is equivalent today because musk and silk both need system 2, but the rule and the note disagree. The draft's new gems rule (LUX_4) must add musk.
